segments.name: Community Banking
products: commercial, retail and related banking services
segments.description: Community bank providing commercial, retail and related banking services and loans to individuals and small businesses in New Jersey.
segments.evidence: The Company's CEO is the chief operating decision maker who uses consolidated net income to assess performance and profitability of our single business segment.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns interest and fees from deposit and loan products sold to individuals and small businesses.
revenueModel.evidence: The Bank offers a variety of deposit and loan products to individuals and small businesses, most of which are located in our primary market.

changes.text: In 2023 Somerset Bank and Regal Bank were combined to form Somerset Regal Bank.
changes.evidence: Somerset Regal Bank was formed through the combination on September 19, 2023 of Somerset Bank and Regal Bank, two New Jersey chartered institutions.
